description: pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:599-600 — LintRunner::run_chain builds partial findings into a local Vec then calls all.append(&mut findings), which requires the intermediate Vec allocation. Replace with all.extend(self.run_cert(...)) to eliminate the intermediate binding and drain-via-append pattern. The deviation.rs run_chain at line 607-609 uses extend correctly.
title: run_chain uses Vec::append when extend suffices
